## Final Accepted Amendments

### `fr-5-9227ab6c`

The new `co2_aq_mmol_per_l` field on `TankSnapshot` (and its deserialization proxy `TankSnapshotRepr`) is required with no `#[serde(default)]` annotation and has no entry in `LEGACY_SNAPSHOT_CHEMISTRY_FIELD_ALIASES`. Any external consumer that has cached or stored a snapshot JSON from a previous version (before this field existed) will fail to deserialize it with a missing-field error. Add `#[serde(default)]` on the `co2_aq_mmol_per_l` field in `TankSnapshotRepr`, or add it as a legacy alias mapping to itself, so old snapshot payloads without this field still parse (defaulting to 0.0).

### `fr-5-ed3ca0d0`

Medium: the new `envelope_reports_non_finite_values` unit test is built on an impossible condition and will fail once the compile blockers are fixed. The test sets `state.water.ph = NaN` and expects `Envelope::check` to see a non-finite snapshot pH (`crates/tank_harness/src/lib.rs:821-829`), but `TankSnapshot::from_state` recomputes `ph` from `projected_carbonate_equilibrium` instead of copying `state.water.ph` (`crates/tank_core/src/types/snapshot.rs:232-248`). In an earlier run of `cargo test -p tank_harness`, this exact assertion already failed because `violations` came back empty. The test needs to exercise a field that actually survives into `TankSnapshot`, or the non-finite validation needs to run on raw state rather than snapshot pH.
